stem:
Which statement describes the relationship between x and y in these two equations?

\[y = 2x\]
\[y = x + 2\]

options.label: F
options.text: In \( y = 2x \) the value of y is 2 more than the value of x, and in \( y = x + 2 \) the value of y is twice the value of x.

options.label: G
options.text: In \( y = 2x \) and in \( y = x + 2 \), the value of y is 2 more than the value of x.

options.label: H
options.text: In \( y = 2x \) and in \( y = x + 2 \), the value of y is twice the value of x.

options.label: J
options.text: In \( y = 2x \) the value of y is twice the value of x, and in \( y = x + 2 \) the value of y is 2 more than the value of x.
